C0140.title: Qufu Police Crack Novel Personal Information Infringement Case, Arresting Man Trading in Stolen Game Accounts
C0140.summary: Public reports show that Tencent's game security team assisted police in Qufu, Shandong, in cracking a case involving Trojan programs and login-session data used to steal game accounts and virtual equipment. The case reflects the risk that game accounts, session-state data, and virtual assets can be stolen in bulk and used in black-gray-market transactions, and it highlights the need for platform and police cooperation against account-theft chains.
